title: Second Babylonian siege of Jerusalem
description: Record first created by the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020)). CFAH dates it as well (added by the CFAH pass); the sort follows the four-tier rule.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH-1 Table 1 baseline: 597 BC (Captivity of Jehoiachin and Ezekiel). Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-10-18): was provisional (Generations) 597 BC.

chronologies.note: CFAH-1 Table 1 (Ussher-Jones biblical baseline adopted by CFAH); not a triangulated anchor point.

chronologies.edition_note: 1st ed. (2020); superseded by the 2nd ed. (2024), which prints "597 BC" (PDF p. 381): the same date.
